# WXYJ Content System

Canonical name: 威熏邑境自媒体内容生成系统

Purpose:
A brand-specific Codex Skill for 威熏邑境, currently centered on
马克瑞普之选亚伯乐1996年单桶 across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat
Channels. It bundles product knowledge, 17 AIGC product references, titles,
captions, tags, comments, prompts, storyboards, QA, and content-run folders.
